description:
Quin is your dream assistant

From meeting notes to CRM updates, Quin handles the busywork so you can stay focused on your clients, not your to-do list. Just message Quin, and it takes care of the rest—capturing notes, creating tasks, drafting follow-up emails, and even prepping you for your next meeting.

Use Quin in ChatGPT to:
  • Capture notes on the go—just send a quick message
  • Prep for upcoming meetings
  • Draft follow-up emails in seconds
  • Update your CRM automatically
  • Answer questions like “What are John Smith's kids named?”
